name: Commerce MVP — Six Weeks
goal: Build an owner-operated e-commerce website in six weeks with a three-person team.
desired_outcome: A tested catalog-to-sandbox-checkout vertical slice deployed for shoppers and an administrator.

clarifications.question: Should payment use a real or sandbox provider?
clarifications.answer: Sandbox provider for the university release.

risk: A blocked checkout contract threatens the critical delivery path.
warning: Payment scope must be reduced or capacity/deadline changed if real-provider certification is confirmed.
